sheets.label: L-44-XXXI · Geological map, 1:200,000
sheets.name: L-44-XXXI
sheets.credit: Extra collection (shared scans) of Soviet geological maps. Scan only.
sheets.license: Rights remain with the original authors or rightsholders. Shared with this project as a teaching collection; no open license established. These scan-derived tiles are not covered by the repository code license.
sheets.accuracy: Four frame corners read by hand from the L-44-XXXI nomenclature (Pulkovo 1942 to WGS84), projective fit. Expect errors of a few hundred metres; corner residual check 2.1 px.
sheets.limitations: Scan only, no color classification. Clipped to the Kazakhstan border. Historic labels and boundaries are retained as printed.
